arxiv-2010-05105.creator: Utkarsh Verma, Narayan Rangaraj
arxiv-2010-05105.description: Abstract Kidney exchange programs have been developed to find compatible kidneys for recipients who have incompatible donors. Currently in India, a deceased donor donates kidneys directly to a deceased donor wait-list.

arxiv-2410-18925.title: Stability analysis of power-law cosmological models
arxiv-2410-18925.creator: Jose Mathew, A Thariq
arxiv-2410-18925.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Jose Mathew, A Thariq. In this paper, we revisit the stability of power-law models, focusing on an alternative approach that differs significantly from the standard approaches used in studying power-law models. In the standard approach, stability is studied by reducing the system of background FRW equations to a one-dimensional system for a new background variable X X in terms of the number of e-foldings.

arxiv-2507-02004.title: STELLA: Self-Evolving LLM Agent for Biomedical Research
arxiv-2507-02004.creator: Ruofan Jin, Zaixi Zhang, Mengdi Wang, Le Cong
arxiv-2507-02004.description: Abstract The rapid growth of biomedical data, tools, and literature has created a fragmented research landscape that outpaces human expertise. While AI agents offer a solution, they typically rely on static, manually-curated toolsets, limiting their ability to adapt and scale. Here, we introduce STELLA, a self-evolving AI agent designed to overcome these limitations.
